package store

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

func historicalWorkflowPayload(action string, raw json.RawMessage) error {
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	switch action {
	case "record_review":
		definition := WorkflowDefinition{ActionDefinitions: []WorkflowActionDefinition{{ID: "probe", Payload: WorkflowPayloadDefinition{Closed: true, Fields: []WorkflowPayloadField{{Name: "review", ValueType: PayloadObject, Required: true, SchemaRef: "workflow_design_decision"}}}}}}
		return validateWorkflowActionPayload(definition, "probe", raw)
	case "record_plan":
		definition, err := BuiltinWorkflowDefinitionForRef("workflow.implementation")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		legacy, err := json.Marshal(map[string]json.RawMessage{"approach": fields["approach"], "decisions": fields["decisions"], "touched_refs": fields["touches"]})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return validateWorkflowActionPayload(definition.Definition, "record_design", legacy)
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported historical action %q", action)
	}
}
